Class AuthController

java.lang.Object
edu.secourse.patientportal.controller.AuthController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/maclogixapi/v1/auth") public class AuthController extends Object
REST Controller responsible for authentication and user registration operations.

This controller exposes endpoints for:

  • User registration (creation of new accounts)
  • User authentication (login and JWT token issuance)

Base Path: /maclogixapi/v1/auth

Security Behavior:

  • Registration endpoint requires ADMIN role
  • Login endpoint is publicly accessible

Authentication Flow:

  1. User submits credentials via login endpoint
  2. AuthenticationService validates credentials
  3. JWT token is generated and returned
  4. Client uses token for subsequent authenticated requests

Security Notes:

  • Passwords are encrypted using BCrypt
  • JWT tokens are time-limited (default: 1 hour)
  • Tokens must be included in the Authorization header

Common HTTP Responses:

  • 200 OK – Successful login
  • 201 Created – Successful registration
  • 400 Bad Request – Validation or malformed request
  • 401 Unauthorized – Invalid credentials
  • 409 Conflict – Duplicate username/email
  • 500 Internal Server Error – Unexpected failure

    • register

      @PostMapping("/register") @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<MLogixApiResponse<User>> register(@Valid @RequestBody @Valid RegisterRequest registerRequest)
      Registers a new user account.

      This endpoint allows an administrator to create a new user in the system. The request body must contain all required user fields, which are validated before processing.

      Endpoint: POST /maclogixapi/v1/auth/register

      Request Body: 

      {
  "username": "johndoe",
  "email": "john@example.com",
  "password": "SafePwd123",
  "firstName": "John",
  "lastName": "Doe"
}

      Success Response (201 Created): Returns the created user wrapped in MLogixApiResponse.

      Error Cases:

      • 400 Bad Request – Validation failure
      • 409 Conflict – Username or email already exists
      Parameters:
      registerRequest - DTO containing user registration details
      Returns:
      ResponseEntity containing the created user and success message

    • login

      @PostMapping("/login") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<MLogixApiResponse<LoginResponse>> login(@Valid @RequestBody @Valid LoginRequest loginRequest)
      Authenticates a user and generates a JWT token.

      This endpoint validates the provided credentials and returns a signed JWT token upon successful authentication. The token can then be used to access protected endpoints.

      Endpoint: POST /maclogixapi/v1/auth/login

      Request Body: 

      {
  "username": "johndoe",
  "password": "SecurePass123"
}

      Success Response (200 OK): Returns a LoginResponse containing user details and JWT token.

      Error Cases:

      • 400 Bad Request – Invalid request format
      • 401 Unauthorized – Invalid username or password

      JWT Usage: Include the token in the Authorization header: 

      Authorization: Bearer <token>
      Parameters:
      loginRequest - DTO containing username and password
      Returns:
      ResponseEntity containing authentication result and JWT token
